title: Hi, I've been making my first game for two months now.
author: errorztw
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1wi5ol5/video/gslxc2vxdxph1/player

    I'm making a card game roguelike in Godot. It's called ELYSION.
    You play as one of four heroes and explore labyrinths in first person. When you run into enemies, you fight them with cards. There are three acts, each with its own location: the Labyrinth of the Styx, the Palace of Hades and Tartarus. The labyrinths are generated on every run, so no two runs are the same. If you die, you start over from the beginning, roguelike style.The setting is Greek mythology. Would love to hear what you think.

comments.author: Ziadjbt78
comments.body: Any demo to try it out?

replies.author: errorztw
replies.body:
Hi, thanks for your interest.

The game is largely ready; there are still some bugs to work on, and I'm also polishing new runs. The game is already playable, with over 60 enemies and 300+ maps, each hero with their own mechanics and maps. There's no demo yet, but I'll be working on the Steam page soon and adding one.

replies.author: errorztw
replies.body:
There will also be full Steam Deck support. The game already runs great on it. I even recorded a video using a tripod. I wanted to post it in the Steam Deck group today, but they only allow "custom games" there on Saturdays, and the post was deleted. I'll add it on Saturday.

I'm already getting 70+ FPS consistently on the Steam Deck.
